_note: Values from SPD Java (actors/mobs/*.java). Damage/DR ranges collapsed to floor(avg) unless 'tuned' says otherwise. delay = 1/baseSpeed.

snake.name: Sewer Snake
snake.spd: HT 4, dmg 1-4; melee only by surprise; magic always hits; slips the first bow shot

crab.name: Sewer Crab
crab.tuned: dmg 4->2, DR 2->1: at 2 attacks/tick SPD avg damage was unbeatable without RNG misses

goo.name: Goo
goo.spd: HT 100, dmg 1-8 (1-12 below half), DR 0-2, pump-up = 3x
goo.tuned: HT 90 (SPD 100; was 70), dmg 4, enraged 6. Pump every 4 acts, every 3 below half HP. Regenerates 1 HP/turn in water; the arena has 2 water tiles like SPD's pools. Each earlier death to Goo removes 15 HT (floor 70, which also stops the enrage) until it is killed. A Goo death also restocks 2 Potions of Healing (DECISIONS #131).

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.spd: HT 25, dmg 2-10, DR 0-5; explodes on death for 6-12 to adjacent
skeleton.tuned: HT 25->20, dmg 4. The death explosion is a 1-tick 3x3 telegraph (5 dmg) instead of instant, so melee heroes can step away

thief.name: Crazy Thief
thief.spd: HT 20, dmg 1-10, DR 0-3; steals an item and flees
thief.tuned: steals 8 gold (dropped back when killed) instead of an item; flees at normal speed so ranged heroes can catch it

dm100.name: DM-100
dm100.tuned: zap is a 1-tick red tile at range 2-4 (5 dmg, DR applies); cooldown 3 actions Needs a clear line; lightning x1.5 if you stand in water (#155).

guard.name: Prison Guard
guard.spd: HT 40, dmg 4-12, DR 0-7; chains and pulls the hero
guard.tuned: HT 40->28, dmg 8->5, DR 3: once per fight pulls the hero adjacent from range 2-3

tengu.name: Tengu
tengu.spd: HT 200, dmg 6-12, DR 0-5; phase 1 teleports & throws shurikens, phase 2 bombs/fire/shockers
tengu.tuned: HT 200->90. Blinks away every 15 HP lost; shuriken = 1-tick red tile (6). Below half HP lobs a 3x3 bomb every 3 actions (2-tick fuse, 8 dmg, also hurts mobs)

bat.name: Vampire Bat
bat.spd: HT 30, dmg 5-18, DR 0-4, speed 2x, heals (damage dealt - 4) on hit
bat.tuned: HT 24, dmg 11->6 (it attacks twice per tick), heals (damage dealt - 2) like SPD's (dealt - 4)

shaman.name: Gnoll Shaman
shaman.tuned: magic zap = 1-tick red tile, 6 dmg ignoring DR, range 2-4, every 2 actions Holds range; red shamans (even uid) weaken, blue ones make you vulnerable for 3 turns (#155).

spinner.name: Cave Spinner
spinner.spd: HT 50, dmg 10-20, DR 0-6; poison bite, webs
spinner.tuned: HT 32, dmg 6, bite adds 3 poison. Spits a web at range 2-4 every 4 actions (red tile; rooted 2 turns: you can attack but not step) (#155).

dm300.name: DM-300
dm300.spd: HT 300, dmg 15-25, DR 0-10; rockfall, toxic vents, supercharge with pylons
dm300.tuned: HT 160, dmg 8, DR 4 (+2 supercharged below half HP). Every 3 actions (2 supercharged) alternates rockfall (+ shape on you, 2-tick fuse, 10) and a toxic gas line (1 tick, 3 + 4 poison). No pylons.

ghoul.name: Dwarven Ghoul
ghoul.spd: HT 45, dmg 16-22, DR 0-4; rises again unless all ghouls die
ghoul.tuned: HT 40, dmg 11; the first time it dies it gets back up with half HP after 2 ticks (red tile on its corpse)

warlock.name: Dwarf Warlock
warlock.spd: HT 70, dmg 12-18, DR 0-8; shadow bolt 12-18 + weakness
warlock.tuned: HT 34; shadow bolt = 1-tick red tile, 9 dmg ignoring DR, every 2 actions Holds range; the bolt weakens for 3 turns (#155).

monk.name: Dwarf Monk
monk.spd: HT 70, dmg 12-25, fast attacks, DR 0-2; disarms
monk.tuned: HT 34, dmg 7, acts twice per tick Every 3rd hit knocks your weapon aside (weakened 2 turns) (#155).

golem.name: Golem
golem.tuned: HT 75, dmg 18, DR 7, acts every 1.5 ticks Every 6 actions pulls a hero it sees at range 3+ to its side (#155).

dking.name: King of Dwarves
dking.spd: HT 300, dmg 15-25, DR 0-10; summons, lifelinks, 3 phases
dking.tuned: HT 140, dmg 10, DR 5. Phase 1 (>1/2 HP): every 3 actions alternates raising 2 Risen Dwarves (only when none are left) and a shadow blast (3x3 on you, 2 ticks, 8 ignoring DR); living dwarves lifelink him (he takes 2/3 damage). Phase 2 (<=1/2): +3 dmg. Phase 3 (<=1/4): throne cracks - no more summons, blasts only.

ghoul_minion.name: Risen Dwarf
ghoul_minion.tuned: weak summon of the Dwarf King

succubus.name: Succubus
succubus.spd: HT 80, dmg 25-30, DR 0-10; charm, lifesteal, blink
succubus.tuned: HT 70, dmg 19, DR 5; heals 5 per bite Once per fight blinks next to you from range 3+, only if nothing else is next to you (#155).

ripper.name: Ripper Demon
ripper.tuned: HT 40, dmg 17, DR 3, acts every 0.6 ticks Telegraphed leap onto your tile from range 2-4 (dmg, then lands), cooldown 4 (#155).

eye.name: Evil Eye
eye.tuned: HT 60, dmg 15; beam = 1-tick red tile, 20 ignoring DR, every 2 actions The beam lights the whole line through you out to range 6; the eye charges while it is up (#155).

scorpio.name: Scorpio
scorpio.spd: HT 110, dmg 30-40, DR 0-16; ranged spit, cripple
scorpio.tuned: HT 72, dmg 20, DR 6; spits at range 2-4, bite poisons The bite cripples (steps cost 2 ticks) for 2 turns (#155).

yog.name: Yog-Dzewa
yog.spd: HT 1000, immobile; fists, larva, beams, phases
yog.tuned: HT 100, DR 6, immobile. Phases: a Burning Fist at the start, a Rotting Fist at 2/3 HP and a Bright Fist at 1/3; Yog takes no damage while a fist lives. Every 3 actions (2 below half HP) alternates larva and a row/column gaze (9). Fists and larva crumble when Yog dies.

fist_burning.name: Burning Fist
fist_burning.tuned: HT 40, dmg 13. Shields Yog while it lives.

fist_rotting.name: Rotting Fist
fist_rotting.tuned: HT 45, dmg 12 + 2 poison. Shields Yog while it lives.

fist_bright.name: Bright Fist
fist_bright.tuned: HT 35, dmg 10, zaps 7 at range. Shields Yog while it lives. Holds range (#155).
